title: How a River Carved the Grand Canyon
board: Hook: the canyon today at sunset, 1.8 km deep
Rewind: the layers vanish, back 1.8 billion years
Ancient mountains on the dark basement rock
The sea comes in: the first layers settle
Window: trilobites on the shallow sea floor
Layer on layer: sandstone, shale, limestone
Window: the warm Redwall sea, crinoids and corals
Window: a lizard crosses the dune desert
Its footprints harden into the Coconino
The last sea leaves the Kaibab rim
The whole block is pushed up about 2 km
Silence: the plateau under the stars
The river cuts down, grain by grain
Frost, flash floods, rockfalls widen the walls
Hard rock cliffs, soft rock slopes: stairs
Today: rafters on the river, a condor overhead
